package fixture

import "context"

// The sanctioned shape: ask, then act. It names no role and decides nothing.
type decisionPoint interface {
	Decide(ctx context.Context, action string) (bool, error)
}

func readRepo(ctx context.Context, pdp decisionPoint) error {
	allowed, err := pdp.Decide(ctx, "repo.read")
	if err != nil || !allowed {
		return errDenied
	}
	return nil
}
